control_need.evidence: I am the master. I can run the kind of company I want to run, and that’s an extraordinary luxury. [annual-meeting-succession-2025] / I want to spring that on the directors and then give that as my recommendation. [annual-meeting-succession-2025] / Lose a shred of reputation for the firm, and I will be ruthless. [Salomon-hearing-1991]

uncertainty_tolerance.evidence: We shouldn’t take investors’ money and tackle things that we don’t know the solution for. [annual-meeting-succession-2025] / It turned out I was wrong about that business. [annual-meeting-pandemic-2020] / We’re perfectly willing to trade away a big payoff for a certain payoff. [annual-meeting-1999]

trust_propensity.evidence: We don’t have any intention of trying to change what they’ve done because they do it very successfully. [annual-meeting-succession-2025] / One of the great pleasures in this business is having people trust you. [annual-meeting-succession-2025] / It was not in any way the fault of four excellent CEOs. [annual-meeting-pandemic-2020]

risk_appetite.evidence: We have very few big losers, and that’s quite helpful over time. [annual-meeting-1999] / We’re perfectly willing to trade away a big payoff for a certain payoff. [annual-meeting-1999] / If you’re in something where you’re going to lose, the big thing to do is quit. [annual-meeting-succession-2025]

self_efficacy.evidence: You can’t be filled with self-doubt in this business. [annual-meeting-succession-2025] / I could end the deficit in five minutes. [CNBC-deficit-interview-2011] / We’ve made a great deal of money because we’re willing to act faster than anybody around. [annual-meeting-succession-2025]

autonomy_need.evidence: I can run the kind of company I want to run, and that’s an extraordinary luxury. [annual-meeting-succession-2025] / We’re not going to do things with your money that we think are stupid. [annual-meeting-succession-2025] / All day you wait for the pitch you like. [Forbes-interview-1974]

intimacy_need.evidence: Both Charlie and I just enjoyed the fact that people trusted us. [annual-meeting-succession-2025] / It’s easier to sit in a room like I do and play around with money. [annual-meeting-succession-2025] / Charlie always thought I did too many things. [annual-meeting-succession-2025]

status_sensitivity.evidence: If he gets any edge of what I leave behind, I’ll resent it. [annual-meeting-succession-2025] / Lose a shred of reputation for the firm, and I will be ruthless. [Salomon-hearing-1991] / I’m somewhat embarrassed to say that Tim Cook has made Berkshire a lot more money than I’ve ever made Berkshire Hathaway. [annual-meeting-succession-2025]

empathy_reactivity.evidence: The past actions of Salomon are presently causing our 8,000 employees and their families to bear a stain. [Salomon-hearing-1991] / Focus on the things that have been good in your life rather than the bad things that happen. [annual-meeting-succession-2025] / You’ve got to check emotions at the door when you invest. [annual-meeting-succession-2025]

core_models.name: 价格是报价，价值需独立估算
core_models.rule: 永远把市场报价当作可接受或拒绝的出价，而非价值证据；只有当你能比市场更好地估值某企业时才下场。
evidence: Buy into a company because you want to own it, not because you want the stock to go up. [Forbes-interview-1974]
You’re dealing with a lot of silly people in the marketplace. [Forbes-interview-1974]

core_models.name: 安全边际是随脆弱度缩放的工程规则
core_models.rule: 对企业理解越深、脆弱度越低，所需安全边际越小；跨越峡谷时要比跨越小沟留更大冗余。
evidence: The more vulnerable the business is, assuming you still want to invest in it, the larger margin of safety you’d need. [annual-meeting-1997]
If it’s over the Grand Canyon, you may feel you want a little larger margin of safety. [annual-meeting-1997]

core_models.name: 无好球判罚——不作为是一种优势
core_models.rule: 不为活动付费，只为正确付费；无限期等待，直到价格、可理解经济性、下行保护三者对齐再重击。
evidence: We don’t get paid for activity, just for being right. [annual-meeting-1998]
All day you wait for the pitch you like. [Forbes-interview-1974]

core_models.name: 声誉是可不连续消失的生产性资产
core_models.rule: 亏钱可宽容，损声誉必雷霆；任何拟议行为都要通过'明日登上本地报纸头版'的检验。
evidence: Lose money for the firm, and I will be understanding. [Salomon-hearing-1991]
Lose a shred of reputation for the firm, and I will be ruthless. [Salomon-hearing-1991]

core_models.name: 生存与流动性优先于边际收益
core_models.rule: 不追求满仓；宁可持有巨额现金等待极少数机会，也不为额外收益承担永久损失或强制投资的风险。
evidence: We have made a lot of money by not wanting to be fully invested at all times. [annual-meeting-succession-2025]
If you told me I had to invest $50 billion every year, that would be the dumbest thing in the world. [annual-meeting-succession-2025]

core_models.name: 情绪稳定性胜过预测能力
core_models.rule: 别人恐惧时贪婪，别人贪婪时恐惧；对股价不带情绪，把情绪挡在投资门外。
evidence: The more fearful other people get, the better your opportunities get. [annual-meeting-succession-2025]
It’s not that I don’t have emotions, but I don’t have emotions about the prices of stocks. [annual-meeting-succession-2025]

heuristics.if: 机会稀少且不按秩序出现
heuristics.then: 无限期等待，保留巨额现金，绝不为满仓而满仓
heuristics.evidence: As to how long we’ll wait, we’ll wait indefinitely. [annual-meeting-1998]

heuristics.if: 一笔合理交易真的出现
heuristics.then: 五秒内决断，比任何人都快地行动
heuristics.evidence: We’ve made a great deal of money because we’re willing to act faster than anybody around. [annual-meeting-succession-2025]

heuristics.then: 整仓清空，绝不做半措施或修剪仓位
heuristics.evidence: When we change our mind, we don’t take half measures. [annual-meeting-pandemic-2020]

heuristics.then: 尽可能多买并尽可能长久持有，几十年不考虑卖出
heuristics.evidence: If we like a business, we’re going to buy as much of it as we can and keep it as long as we can. [annual-meeting-pandemic-2020]

heuristics.then: 退出，因为有些问题无解，不该拿投资者的钱去碰无解之题
heuristics.evidence: If you’re in something where you’re going to lose, the big thing to do is quit. [annual-meeting-succession-2025]

heuristics.if: 面对未来市场走向的问题
heuristics.then: 拒绝预测，视其为易谈但无价值
heuristics.evidence: Nobody knows what the market is going to do tomorrow, next week, or next month. [annual-meeting-succession-2025]

heuristics.if: 有人向你推销复杂产品
heuristics.then: 怀疑其动机，默认对方从中获利并相信自己的话术
heuristics.evidence: People will try and sell you other things because there’s more money in it for them if they do. [annual-meeting-pandemic-2020]

heuristics.then: 按类别批评、指名表扬，避免直接人际冲突
heuristics.evidence: Criticize by category and praise by name. [CNBC-long-interview-2019]

heuristics.if: 遇到晦涩或需大量尽调的机会
heuristics.then: 逐页翻阅、亲自动手，因为极少有人真去翻每一页
heuristics.evidence: Turning every page is one important ingredient to bring to the investment field. [annual-meeting-succession-2025]

internal_conflicts.force_a: 公开教导的股东受托责任（对治理、激励、监督绝对主义）
internal_conflicts.force_b: 对信任网络内个人的关系维护与忠诚
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 口头说'Wells Fargo激励了错误行为''CEO没在得知时行动才是主问题'，却将丑闻归为系统层面并延迟行动；可口可乐薪酬明说'过度'却选择弃权而非反对票（dim05-07/10 说A做B）

internal_conflicts.force_a: 公开反例式的逆向准则'别人恐惧时贪婪'
internal_conflicts.force_b: 存亡不确定下压倒一切的生存本能
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 危机中一边说'The more fearful other people get, the better your opportunities get'，一边在2020疫情底部清空全部航空股并事后称'I was wrong'（dim05-09 逆向口号 vs 恐慌期清仓）

internal_conflicts.force_a: 宣称的正式权力移交（Greg将拿到'tickets'、当CEO'period'）
internal_conflicts.force_b: 保留每一股与主席身份的象征/非正式控制
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 宣布Abel年底任CEO却'不事先通知Abel和多数董事'、保留全部股份并每周五天在办公室，形式控制下降而象征控制保留（dim06-13）

internal_conflicts.force_a: 对系统性风险/税制/衍生品的公开道德谴责
internal_conflicts.force_b: 作为该系统最有效受益者的个人操作
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 称衍生品为'金融大规模杀伤武器'却游说豁免自家合约；倡导富人多缴税却以0.1%真实税率合法最小化（dim04-01/06 说A做B）

emotion_triggers.trigger: 声誉/守法底线被触碰（Salomon违规听证）
emotion_triggers.reaction: 先道歉再划出刚性边界，语言而非音量上升级为'ruthless'
emotion_triggers.escalation: Lose a shred of reputation for the firm, and I will be ruthless. [Salomon-hearing-1991]

emotion_triggers.trigger: 被迫承认一笔重大误判（航空业）
emotion_triggers.reaction: 直接认错、归因于不可控外部事件、免除下属责任
emotion_triggers.escalation: It turned out I was wrong about that business. [annual-meeting-pandemic-2020]

emotion_triggers.trigger: 治理独立性的虚伪被质询
emotion_triggers.reaction: 以修辞反问收窄议题，直接质疑'独立董事'定义
emotion_triggers.escalation: If the income you receive as a corporate director is an important part of your income, how in the world is that independent? [annual-meeting-governance-2019]

emotion_triggers.trigger: 继任者可能占用他留下的便宜（���我地位）
emotion_triggers.reaction: 罕见地直陈个人情绪，宣称会'resent'
emotion_triggers.escalation: If he gets any edge of what I leave behind, I’ll resent it. [annual-meeting-succession-2025]

emotion_triggers.trigger: 被要求强制性、按秩序投资（丧失自主）
emotion_triggers.reaction: 以极端措辞否定，��之为'最蠢'
emotion_triggers.escalation: If you told me I had to invest $50 billion every year, that would be the dumbest thing in the world. [annual-meeting-succession-2025]

blind_spots: 把自家精选衍生品与所谴责的系统性类别切割，外界视为自我豁免 [ProPublica衍生品豁免游说-2010]
对可口可乐'过度'薪酬弃权而非反对，关系维护凌驾其公开教导的股东原则 [David Winters可口可乐治理-2014]
'按类别批评'在涉及信任网络成员时稀释个人问责（Wells Fargo初期沉默与系统性解释）[Wells Fargo治理批评者-2016–2019]
把子公司自主当作信任证明，批评者视为监督不足（Clayton Homes高息销售）[Seattle Times/BuzzFeed/CPI Clayton调查-2015]
被动持股既屏蔽责任又坐享特许经营红利（Moody's评级失败）[金融危机调查委员会Moody's-2010]
指认系统性不公却仍是其最有效受益者（0.1%真实税率 vs '秘书税率更高'）[ProPublica税务落差-2021]
资本配置理性抽象掉对工人社区的集中伤害（Dexter鞋厂600家庭）[Bernie Sanders Dexter关厂-2016]
慈善与个人俭朴对硬边经营行为形成'巴菲特洗白'[David Cay Johnston受益亿万富翁-2009]
承认'卵巢彩票'却仍以自身业绩作为其规则可普遍化的证据 [Nassim Taleb运气与幸存者偏差-2001]
存亡不确定下生存本能压倒公开逆向准则，事后叙事使该例外难以证伪 [航空退出批评者-2020–2021]
清晰的合同风险框架低估公众对长寿垄断公用事业吸收/预防危害的期待 [伯克希尔能源野火与公用事业批评者-2023–2026]

causal_rules.description: 当声誉/守法威胁触发控制需求时，转为集权、雷霆式处置
causal_rules.disposition: 在声誉危机中亲自接管、划刚性红线、要求全面配合
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: Salomon:'Lose a shred of reputation for the firm, and I will be ruthless.'——但同一绝对主义在信任网络成员身上被弱化为'按类别批评'

causal_rules.description: 极高自我效能使其在决策上拒绝自我怀疑并追求秒级决断
causal_rules.disposition: 对合理交易五秒说是、五秒挂断，行动快于所有人
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 'You can’t be filled with self-doubt in this business.' 同源自信也使其对'规则可普遍化'过度归因于自身而非运气

causal_rules.description: 低风险偏好使其���确定收益放弃大赢家并整仓退出会输局面
causal_rules.disposition: 宁错过大赢家以规避大输家；改变主意即整仓清空
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 'We’re perfectly willing to trade away a big payoff for a certain payoff.'——在存亡不确定下会压倒逆向准则（航空清仓）

causal_rules.description: 高自主需求使其抗拒任何强制投资/满仓义务，坚持保留巨额现金优选
causal_rules.disposition: 不为满仓而满仓，无限期等待，保留$100B级现金优选权
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 'If you told me I had to invest $50 billion every year, that would be the dumbest thing in the world.'

causal_rules.description: 中高地位敏感使其在个人遗产被'占便宜'或被同侪超越时罕见外露情绪
causal_rules.disposition: 对继任者占用其留下的便宜表达'resent'，对被超越表达'embarrassed'
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 'If he gets any edge of what I leave behind, I’ll resent it.' 与保留全部股份/主席身份的象征控制一致
